mini_task_spec:
Using the `estimate` tool from the `tokenbudget` brick (which applies a chars/4 integer-division heuristic for code files), determine the token cost of every non-test TypeScript file located **directly** in `test-repo/packages/core/router/` (i.e. `maxdepth 1`; do not recurse into subdirectories such as `interfaces/`, `request/`, or `utils/`; exclude any file whose name ends in `.spec.ts`).

List the **top 3 files by estimated token count** in **descending order**. Report each file as a relative path starting from `test-repo/` followed by its estimated token count, one entry per line, in this format:

```
packages/core/router/<filename>.ts: <N> tokens
```
